We are completely in love with Ladakh, and we're sure you'll fall in love with it too! This is our effort to bring some of the most pristine, spell binding, and unexplored cultures to the world. Ladakh offers you not only a memorable experience of exploring of beautiful surroundings, but also the inward journey of introspection. For the adrenaline junkies, we have adventure tours including trekking, biking and white water rafting.

For people seeking peace of mind and rejuvenation this is the perfect opportunity to experience a beautiful culture and way of life, The cultural and spiritual tours will leave you with a soul awakening experience, introducing you to a way of living a contented life in this harsh rugged terrain.

We, a team of 8 persons between 55 and 61 years of age, made a trip of Ladakh from Leh to Leh in first week of September 2025. Our trip was organised and customised by Shaveena as per our special requests. We enjoyed Ladakh’s beauty thanks to meticulous planning by her. She always keep in touch with guests and update them about the weather forecast. All the accommodations and food arranged by her are good, specially at remote places like Karzok, Spangmik etc. The driver of the vehicle (Mr. Tundup) was a great companion and always provided good suggestion and guidance during the trip.
Appreciate Shaveena’s courteous behaviour and the trust and bond she developed with the team. Shall definitely recommend her to our friends and relatives.

We (team of 7 including a 10 year old girl) made a trip to Ladakh via Manali in the 2nd week of July, 2022. Enjoyed the awesome natural beauty of  Ladakh. Interesting road journey from Manali to Leh through charming passes. We took the blessings of  God created Pangong and Tsomoriri lakes. Nubra valley gave us a feel of cold desert with camel ride along with stay in luxury tent. We must thank Shaveena and Stoby for arranging comfortable accommodation with good food and  transport arrangement. Special thanks to Shaveena for additional taking care of my wife, providing oxygen cylinder to avoid any inconvenience in some remote places.

Appreciate Shaveena's courteous behaviour and could  develope trust and bonding for our days ahead and shall refer our friends without hesitation.

Best regards
